sources.evidence_extract: Exact manufacturer-authored -5 drawing retrieved through JLCPCB and the stable PDF URL on the exact LCSC listing; both downloads have identical SHA256. Mirror authority does not close manufacturer-primary trust. Maintained SPDT ON-NONE-ON: common 2 joins 3 in position 1 or 1 in position 3. Q silver contacts: 5 A at 120 VAC or 28 VDC, 2 A at 250 VAC; no resistive-load qualifier stated. Body 12.70 x 6.86 mm, lug pitch 4.70 mm, lug width 2.03 mm and thickness 0.76 mm, projection 3.96 mm; drawing general two-decimal tolerance +/-0.25 mm. Solder lugs and threaded panel mounting, not the manufacturer PC-pin variant. Bushing 1/4-40 UNS-2A; opening diameter 6.35 mm. Mechanical life 40,000 operations. Ambient -40 to +85 C. Initial contact resistance 10 milliohms maximum at 2-4 VDC, 100 mA. No lamp capacitive-inrush or contact-wetting qualification.
